hotspot.title: 重庆 8D 魔幻地形又成全网梗
hotspot.summary: 穿楼轻轨、空中立交、倒挂的居民楼——重庆的 8D 地形一次次火出圈，海外博主直呼超现实。点进去看正经航拍。

summaryZh: 8D魔幻山城，轻轨穿楼而过，洪崖洞夜景如千与千寻。火锅必须是九宫格才够味。

guide.bestTime: March to May and September to November are ideal — mild weather, clear skies for the mountain city views. Avoid July–August (brutal humidity, 40°C+ rooftop heat) and the foggy winter stretch when the 8D skyline hides.
guide.getThere: Fly into Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport (CKG), 30 min by metro line 3/10 to the center. High-speed rail links Beijing (≈7h), Chengdu (≈1.5h) and Xi'an (≈5h). The metro itself is the attraction — line 2 literally passes through a residential building at Liziba.
itinerary: Day 1 — Liziba (train-through-building) → Eling Park for the 8D skyline → Hongyadong at dusk for the 'Spirited Away' stilt houses
Day 2 — Ciqikou ancient town → Yangtze River cable car → Nanbin Road night walk
Day 3 — Wulong Karst (Tianlong bridge, Natural Three Bridges) day trip, or Yangtze cable car + Gele Mountain
food: Nine-grid hotpot (九宫格火锅) — split broths by spice level, numb-and-spicy is the local default
Xiaomian (重庆小面) — 6am street noodles, the real breakfast of champions
Chongqing chicken with peanuts (歌乐山辣子鸡) — hunt the chicken through a mountain of dried chili
hiddenGems: Huangjueping staircase streets — a vertical maze of staircases where your GPS gives up, perfect for cyberpunk photos
Testbed 2 (贰厂) — a converted wartime printing factory, now indie cafés and art squats with rooftop city views
